scenarios.name: Apply an inserted model-state table row

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Capture State followed by active Copy State
the extrusion is suppressed in Capture State and computed in Copy State
the user inserts a row after Capture State
the generated member appears between Capture State and Copy State in the model browser
the user activates the generated member
the generated member is marked active
the extrusion row is struck through
the solid is absent from the viewport
